evidence.title: File:Ensalada Neris Villacob.jpg
evidence.description: Es una combinación de ingredientes contrastados que se balancean entre sí, integrando mini-vegetales y frutos secos para crear una armonía sutil y artística en lo visual, y de texturas en cuanto al tacto e integrando por supuesto un explosión de sabores balanceados en cuanto al gusto. Ingredientes: Combinación de baby lechugas, escarola, rugula, radicchio, tomates cherry, cebollitas encurtidas, nueces de macadamia para agregar textura, baby potatoes del Peru, puede ser papa morada o rosada como carbohidrato sutil, cranberry deshidratadas y vinagre balsámico para añadir acidez y miel de maple para balancearlo. Esta suele ser una ensalada autónoma para acompañar Proteinas sin mas carbohidratos ( Carnes nobles de cordero o venado, aves salvajes como faisán y pescados)

evidence.title: File:Pastirmali pide.jpg
evidence.description: Pastırmalı pide is a kind of Turkish pide meal made with "pastırma" and generally with an egg on it. The word "pide" is generally omitted in informal speech, especially in the Black sea Region of Turkey, where pide is almost the prime food. (Other typical Black Sea pides, the one with "kıyma" / minced meat is called simply "kıymalı" and the one with "çökelek" cheese is called "çökelekli" in the region. Of course there is also the "yağlı" with butter and eggs.) In parts of the Balkans, with Ottoman tradition, somehow the word " pastirmalija " has acquired the meaning of pide even if without any pastirma used in it.

evidence.title: File:Filipino hotcakes.jpg
evidence.description:
Filipino or "Pinoy" hotcake is a variation of pancake from the Philippines. It is thin, spongy, and has a distinct yellow color. It is made from flour, eggs, salt, baking powder, food coloring, and milk. It is basted with margarine and sprinkled with granulated sugar before serving. 
These hotcakes are usually eaten as a snack instead of breakfast. You’d often see these hotcakes sold by vendors in plazas, street sides, schools, and other public spaces.
